analogy.rationale: The annotated targets are largely ion pumps/channels (Na+/K+-ATPases, SERCA, CLCN2) whose inhibition alters ion homeostasis; transcriptional responses are typically modest and most similar to other ion transport modulators, especially chloride channel blockade given CLCN2 is a direct target.
